measures.label: GDP: monthly growth
measures.basis: Monthly change in real gross domestic product at market prices
measures.note: Monthly real GDP growth is volatile and subject to revision.
caveats: Early estimate; subject to revision.

measures.label: GDP: three-month growth
measures.basis: Real GDP growth across the latest three months
measures.note: A rolling three-month estimate that can be revised.
caveats: Early estimate; subject to revision.

measures.label: GDP: annual growth
measures.basis: Change in real GDP compared with the same month one year earlier
measures.note: Annual GDP growth is an estimate and can be revised.
caveats: Early estimate; subject to revision.

measures.label: CPI inflation
measures.basis: Annual change in the Consumer Prices Index
measures.note: Lower inflation means prices rise more slowly, not that they have fallen.
caveats: CPI does not describe every household's personal inflation rate.

measures.label: Unemployment rate
measures.basis: ILO unemployed people as a share of the economically active population
measures.note: A rolling three-month Labour Force Survey estimate; subject to sampling uncertainty and revision.
caveats: Survey estimate; subject to sampling uncertainty and revision.

measures.label: Employment rate
measures.basis: People aged 16 to 64 in employment as a share of the population aged 16 to 64
measures.note: A rolling three-month Labour Force Survey estimate; subject to sampling uncertainty and revision.
caveats: Survey estimate; subject to sampling uncertainty and revision.

measures.label: Economic inactivity rate
measures.basis: People aged 16 to 64 not in the labour force as a share of the population aged 16 to 64
measures.note: A rolling three-month Labour Force Survey estimate; subject to sampling uncertainty and revision.
caveats: Survey estimate; subject to sampling uncertainty and revision.

measures.label: Vacancies
measures.basis: Estimated number of vacant employee jobs
measures.note: Vacancies are an estimate of unfilled employee jobs, not a count of unemployed people.
caveats: Survey estimate; subject to sampling uncertainty and revision.

measures.label: NHS waiting list
measures.basis: Referral-to-treatment waiting pathways, not unique people
measures.note: NHS England referral-to-treatment pathways; a person can wait on more than one pathway.
caveats: A person can wait on more than one pathway.

measures.label: Debt as a share of GDP
measures.basis: Public sector net debt excluding public sector banks divided by GDP
measures.note: A fiscal stock-to-GDP ratio, not an annual borrowing flow.
caveats: A fiscal stock-to-GDP ratio, not an annual borrowing flow.

measures.label: Public sector net debt
measures.basis: Public sector net debt excluding public sector banks, in current prices
measures.note: A debt stock in cash terms; it is not the amount borrowed during the month.
caveats: This is a fiscal stock, not an annual borrowing flow.

measures.label: Central government receipts
measures.basis: Nominal central-government receipts on the ONS accounting basis
measures.note: Monthly nominal receipts; not all receipts are taxes. Compare the same month across years to account for seasonality.
caveats: Nominal monthly flow; not all receipts are taxes.

measures.label: Net migration
measures.basis: Long-term immigration minus long-term emigration
measures.note: ONS long-term migration estimates; not a count of small-boat arrivals.
caveats: Provisional official statistics in development; subject to revision.

measures.label: Long-term immigration
measures.basis: People immigrating to the UK for at least 12 months under the ONS long-term migration definition
measures.note: ONS long-term immigration estimates; not a count of all border crossings.
caveats: Provisional official statistics in development; subject to revision.

measures.label: Long-term emigration
measures.basis: People emigrating from the UK for at least 12 months under the ONS long-term migration definition
measures.note: ONS long-term emigration estimates; not a count of all border crossings.
caveats: Provisional official statistics in development; subject to revision.

measures.label: Real wages: regular pay growth
measures.basis: ONS regular pay growth in real terms, CPIH-adjusted
measures.note: ONS's directly published real-terms regular-pay growth figure; provisional and subject to revision.
caveats: Published directly by ONS and subject to revision.

measures.label: Real wages: total pay growth
measures.basis: ONS total pay growth in real terms, including bonuses, CPIH-adjusted
measures.note: ONS's directly published real-terms total-pay growth figure; provisional and subject to revision.
caveats: Published directly by ONS and subject to revision.

measures.label: House prices: annual change
measures.basis: Annual percentage change in the UK House Price Index
measures.note: The HPI change series can lag the bulletin's release month; average price is a separate headline-only value.
caveats: Provisional house-price estimates are subject to revision; the observation period can lag the bulletin date.

measures.label: Private rent: annual change
measures.basis: Annual change in the ONS Price Index of Private Rents (PIPR)
measures.note: PIPR measures changes in rents paid by private tenants; it is not an estimate of an individual household's rent.
caveats: The latest estimates are provisional and subject to revision; Northern Ireland estimates and country-level collection have stated comparability limits.

measures.label: Average monthly private rent
measures.basis: ONS headline average monthly rent for UK privately rented properties
measures.note: An aggregate rental level, not a household-specific rent or affordability measure.
caveats: The latest estimates are provisional and subject to revision; Northern Ireland estimates and country-level collection have stated comparability limits.
